title: Hunter's Mark
description: Finish a tier 1 Slayer quest by defeating its boss.

giver.name: Morwen Ashgrave
giver.text: Contracts aren't paid for by trying. Kill enough of the line to fill the bar, then face what rises. Finish one, and I'll call you a hunter. Not before.

objectives.label: Finish a Slayer quest of tier 1
